title: August and the Songbook
author: M. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Petra Lockridge, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
